resources.string: The result will replace “%1$s”. The current version is kept in the Trash for 30 days and can be restored from there.
Saved in the same file — the previous version is in the Trash
The picked file “%1$s” does not match the file “%2$s” was opened from (different name or size). Replacing it with your edited version erases its content.
Could not move to the Trash
There is not enough space to move these items to the Trash. Delete them permanently? This cannot be undone.
%1$d annotation(s) could not be saved — they are still pending, nothing was lost
Not undone: %1$d later change(s) would be undone too. Use the edit history to go back that far.
Save the annotations you are editing first, then undo file changes.
The file may have been deleted or moved, or the memory card was removed. Open it from its new location.
No permission to read the file
The app that shared this file no longer allows reading it. Open it again from that app or from a file manager.
The file does not look like a PDF, is damaged, or its download did not finish. Download it again and retry, or open it with another app.
Something went wrong opening the file
Try again. If it keeps failing, open the file with another app.
